text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've finished work for the day and am
thinking of
taking a stroll, when...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, heeey! ♪ You wouldn't happen to
be about
to go on a walk, would you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. If sooo... I'd just looove it if you'd
join me
for a bit! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Flash!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
#CurrenAfterSchool #CuteCafe #Pink

#StrawberryMilk #Probably

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Flash!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
#CuteCurrenChan #SelfieBreak #Date
#With
#Friend

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. Do you think I'm... cute
today?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yay! ♪ Ehehe, I'm so happy. Keep the
photos
coming! ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
#HeadingHome #Sunset
#CurrenInSepia... And
that's a wrap!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Thanks for hanging out with me today! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! We got sooo many cute pics! And
having
someone take the pics for you is
just as fun as I
th—

text_block_list.name: College Girl
text_block_list.text:
I finally found you! Yes, you there! The

Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Me?

text_block_list.name: College Girl
text_block_list.text:
You're Curren Chan, right?! Oooh,
you're even
cuter in person than on
Umastagram!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wow, so you follow me?! Thanks so
much! ☆
Since we're here, do you wanna
take a selfie?

text_block_list.name: College Girl
text_block_list.text:
R-really?! Could I—I mean, of course
not! I didn't
come here to get all
chummy with you!

text_block_list.name: College Girl
text_block_list.text:
Listen up. I'm here to challenge you. I
might not
be anywhere near as popular
as you right now,
but I swear I'll get
more likes than you one day!

text_block_list.name: College Girl
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait. I'll beat you using the one
thing I
have that you don't—womanly
charm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having said her piece, the girl leaves
briskly,
stealing occasional glances at
Curren Chan as she
goes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...She left.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hmmm... Womanly charm, huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer... Am I lacking in womanly
charm?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Really? So what about me is womanly?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Can you look at me, please? I want you
to answer
without averting your eyes. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's no lie that Curren Chan is dripping
with
charm, but as for being womanly, I
find myself
hard-pressed to find a
response...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know. You can't decide, right? Like
I'm sooo
charming you can't settle on an
answer? Hehe, in
that case...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I want you to help me discover my most
defining
womanly charm! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I feel comfortable asking since it's you...
So,
pretty please?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! ♪ Thank you! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to turn Curren Chan down, I find
myself
recruited to the search for her
womanly charm...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Sooomehooow, I get the feeling
you're
just paying me lip service. Did
you really mean
what you said?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
See, I knew it! Geez! In that case, I'll just
have to
discover my womanly charm on
my own and show
you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And when I do and your heart skips a
beat... you'd
better have some kind of
present for me! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having said that, Curren Chan leans in
to look at
me close with a mischievous
smile.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... Is that so? But you know what?
I'm not
giving up!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You might not get it right now, but boy
will you
be surprised when you see how
grown up I
become! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And when that time comes, you have to
tell me if
I made your heart flutter,
okay?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having said that, Curren Chan gives me
an impish
wink.
